//: Not a build config - backend/ and frontend/ each have their own, and `npm run build` cds into each before invoking its compiler. This one exists only so `node --import tsx --test core/test/*.ts`, run from the repo root by test:ui, can resolve the `$lib` alias that several frontend/src/lib modules under test import through. tsx picks its tsconfig by walking up from process.cwd(), not from the file being transformed, so without this the alias resolves fine when a test is run from frontend/ and fails from the root.
